papers_analyzed.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
key_findings: Single VQ tokenizer (8192 codebook, 1024 tokens per 512x512 image)
QK-norm and z-loss for training stability
Trained on ~10T tokens of interleaved data
papers_analyzed.relevance: Primary baseline for single-encoder unified approach

papers_analyzed.title: Visual Instruction Tuning (LLaVA)
key_findings: CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder + linear projection + Vicuna LLM
Two-stage training: alignment then instruction tuning
Demonstrates effectiveness of visual instruction tuning

papers_analyzed.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training (SigLIP)
key_findings: Sigmoid loss decouples batch size from loss computation
Memory efficient, enables large batch training
Better than softmax at small batch sizes
papers_analyzed.relevance: Chosen as understanding encoder for DualVE

papers_analyzed.title: Autoregressive Model Beats Diffusion: LlamaGen
key_findings: Vanilla Llama architecture for image generation
papers_analyzed.relevance: Validates AR generation approach; generation encoder design

contract_updates: Chameleon's single-encoder limitation confirmed as motivation for decoupling
SigLIP chosen over CLIP for understanding encoder due to efficiency
LlamaGen's VQ-GAN design adopted for generation encoder
LLaVA's two-stage training extended to four-stage pipeline
